news.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.19%, highest since before the financial crisis
news.description: Global bond markets remain on edge as traders monitor central bank responses to renewed inflation fears.

news.title: Mortgage rates surge to highest level since July
news.description: Mortgage rates continued to move higher Tuesday on uncertainty over the war with Iran. They are at the highest level since last July.

news.title: Google debuts new AI models, personal AI agents in effort to keep pace with OpenAI and Anthropic
news.description: Google made a number of AI announcements at its annual developer conference, rolling out more-advanced models and agentic tools for its expansive user base.
